title: User.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe a user resource.

Apple Business API 2.6+

> **Note:** When additional attributes are added by Apple, they appear automatically, without requiring a newer version of the API.

costCenter.description: The cost center the user belongs to in the organization.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time that the user was created.

department.description: The department the user belongs to in the organization.

division.description: The division the user belongs to in the organization.

email.description: The email address of the user.

employeeNumber.description: The employee number of the user.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

isExternalUser.description: Indicates if the user is an external user invited to the organization.

jobTitle.description: The job title the user holds in the organization.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

managedAppleAccount.description: The Apple Account of the user registered in the system.

middleName.description: The middle name of the user.

phoneNumbers.description: The phone numbers of the user.

roleOuList.description: A list of role-organizational unit mappings for the user, where each item contains a `roleName` and `ouId` representing the role of a user at a particular organizational unit.

startDateTime.description: The date and time when the user started as part of the organization.

status.description: The status of the user. See [UserStatus](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applebusinessapi/userstatus) for possible values.

updatedDateTime.description: The date and time that the user was last updated.
